Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the Name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ لَا يَصِفُهُ نَعْتُ الْوَاصِفِيْنَ
Translation: O Allah, O He whom the descriptions of those who attempt to describe cannot comprehend

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ لَا يُجَاوِزُهُ رَجَاءُ الرَّاجِيْنَ
Translation: O He whom the hopes of those who hope cannot surpass

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ لَا يَضِيْعُ لَدَيْهِ أَجْرُ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ
Translation: O He with whom the reward of the good-doers is never lost

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ هُوَ مُنْتَهَى خَوْفِ الْعَابِدِيْنَ
Translation: O He who is the ultimate object of fear for the worshippers

Arabic text: وَيَا مَنْ هُوَ غَايَةُ خَشْيَةِ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ
Translation: O He who is the ultimate goal of reverence for the pious

Arabic text: هَذَا مَقَامُ مَنْ تَدَاوَلَتْهُ أَيْدِيْ الذُّنُوْبِ
Translation: This is the position of one whose hands have been seized by sins

Arabic text: وَقَادَتْهُ أَزِمَّةُ الْخَطَايَا
Translation: And who has been led by the reins of offenses

Arabic text: وَاسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيْهِ الشَّيْطَانُ
Translation: And over whom Satan has gained mastery

Arabic text: فَقَصَّرَ عَمَّا أَمَرْتَ بِهِ تَفْرِيْطًا
Translation: So he fell short of what You commanded through negligence

Arabic text: وَتَعَاطَى مَا نَهَيْتَ عَنْهُ تَغْرِيْرًا
Translation: And engaged in what You prohibited through delusion

Arabic text: كَالْجَاهِلِ بِقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: Like one ignorant of Your power over him

Arabic text: أَوْ كَالْمُنْكِرِ فَضْلَ إِحْسَانِكَ إِلَيْهِ
Translation: Or like one who denies the grace of Your favor toward him

Arabic text: حَتَّى إِذَا انْفَتَحَ لَهُ بَصَرُ الْهُدَى
Translation: Until, when the eye of guidance was opened for him

Arabic text: وَتَقَشَّعَتْ عَنْهُ سَحَائِبُ الْعَمَى أَحْصَى مَا ظَلَمَ بِهِ نَفْسَهُ
Translation: And the clouds of blindness were dispelled from him, he realized what he had done to wrong himself

Arabic text: وَفَكَّرَ فِيْمَا خَالَفَ بِهِ رَبَّهُ
Translation: And reflected upon how he had opposed his Lord

Arabic text: فَرَأَى كَبِيْرَ عِصْيَانِهِ كَبِيْرًا
Translation: And saw his great disobedience as great

Arabic text: وَجَلِيْلَ مُخَالَفَتِهِ جَلِيْلًا
Translation: And his serious opposition as serious

Arabic text: فَأَقْبَلَ نَحْوَكَ مُؤَمِّلًا لَكَ، مُسْتَحْيِيًا مِنْكَ
Translation: So he turned toward You, hoping in You and feeling shy before You

Arabic text: وَوَجَّهَ رَغْبَتَهُ إِلَيْكَ ثِقَةً بِكَ
Translation: And he directed his desires toward You, trusting in You

Arabic text: فَأَمَّكَ بِطَمَعِهِ يَقِيْنًا
Translation: So he came to You with his hope, certain of You

Arabic text: وَقَصَدَكَ بِخَوْفِهِ إِخْلاَصًا
Translation: And he approached You with his fear, sincerely

Arabic text: قَدْ خَلَا طَمَعُهُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَطْمُوْعٍ فِيْهِ غَيْرِكَ
Translation: His hope freed from all objects of hope except You

Arabic text: وَأَفْرَخَ رَوْعُهُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَحْذُوْرٍ مِنْهُ سِوَاكَ
Translation: And his fear purged from all objects of fear other than You

Arabic text: فَمَثَّلَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْـكَ مُتَضَرِّعًا
Translation: So he stood before You pleading

Arabic text: وَغَمَّضَ بَصَرَهُ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ مُتَخَشِّعًا
Translation: And lowered his eyes to the ground, humbly

Arabic text: وَطَأْطَأَ رَأْسَهُ لِعِزَّتِكَ مُتَذَلِّلًا
Translation: And bowed his head before Your might, submissively

Arabic text: وَأَبَثَّكَ مِنْ سِرِّهِ مَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنْهُ خُضُوْعًا
Translation: And he confessed to You his secrets of which You are more aware than he is, in humility

Arabic text: وَعَدَّدَ مِنْ ذُنُوْبِهِ مَا أَنْتَ أَحْصَى لَهَا خُشُوْعًا
Translation: And he counted his sins of which You have better knowledge, in meekness

Arabic text: وَاسْتَغَاثَ بِكَ مِنْ عَظِيْمِ مَاوَقَعَ بِهِ فِيْ عِلْمِكَ
Translation: And he sought Your help against the terrible situation which is in Your knowledge

Arabic text: وَقَبِيْحِ مَا فَضَحَهُ فِيْ حُكْمِكَ
Translation: And the ugly acts which have disgraced him in Your judgment

Arabic text: مِنْ ذُنُوْبٍ أَدْبَرَتْ لَذَّاتُهَا فَذَهَبَتْ
Translation: The sins whose pleasures have passed and gone

Arabic text: وَأَقَامَتْ تَبِعَاتُهَا فَلَزِمَتْ
Translation: While their harmful consequences have stayed and adhered

Arabic text: لَا يُنْكِرُ يَا إِلٰهِيْ عَدْلَكَ اِنْ عَاقَبْتَهُ
Translation: He does not deny, my God, Your justice if You punish him

Arabic text: وَلَا يَسْتَعْظِمُ عَفْوَكَ اِنْ عَفَوْتَ عَنْهُ وَرَحِمْتَهُ
Translation: Nor does he consider Your pardon too great if You forgive him and have mercy on him

Arabic text: لِأَنَّكَ الرَّبُّ الْكَرِيْمُ
Translation: Because You are the Generous Lord

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْ لَا يَتَعَاظَمُهُ غُفْرَانُ الذَّنْبِ الْعَظِيْمِ
Translation: For whom the forgiveness of terrible sins is not difficult

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ فَهَا أَنَا ذَا قَدْ جِئْتُكَ مُطِيْعًا
Translation: O Allah, here I am, I have come to You in obedience

Arabic text: لِأَمْرِكَ فِيْمَا أَمَرْتَ بِهِ مِنَ الدُّعَاءِ
Translation: To Your command in which You have commanded supplication

Arabic text: مُتَنَجِّزًا وَعْدَكَ فِيْمَا وَعَدْتَ بِهِ مِنَ الْإِجَابَةِ
Translation: Seeking fulfillment of Your promise in which You have promised to answer

Arabic text: إِذْ تَقُولُ اُدْعُوْنِيْ أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ
Translation: As You say: "Call upon Me and I will answer you"

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: وَاَلْقَنِيْ بِمَغْفِـرَتِكَ كَمَا لَقِيْتُكَ بِإِقْرَارِي
Translation: And meet me with Your forgiveness just as I have met You with my confession

Arabic text: وَارْفَعْنِيْ عَنْ مَصَارِعِ الذُّنُوْبِ كَمَا وَضَعْتُ لَكَ نَفْسِي
Translation: And raise me from the places where sins fall just as I have humbled myself before You

Arabic text: وَاسْتُرْنِيْ بِسِتْرِكَ كَمَا تَأَنَّيْتَنِيْ عَنِ الْأِنْتِقَامِ مِنِّي
Translation: And cover me with Your protection just as You have held back from taking vengeance on me

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ وَثَبِّتْ فِيْ طَاعَتِكَ نِيَّتِي
Translation: O Allah, make firm my intention in obeying You

Arabic text: وَأَحْكِمْ فِيْ عِبَادَتِكَ بَصِيْـرَتِي
Translation: And strengthen my insight in worshipping You

Arabic text: وَوَفِّقْنِيْ مِنَ الْأَعْمَالِ
Translation: And give me success in works

Arabic text: لِمَا تَغْسِلُ بِهِ دَنَسَ الخَطَايَا عَنِّي
Translation: By which You will wash away the defilement of sins from me

Arabic text: وَتَوَفَّنِيْ عَلَى مِلَّتِكَ وَمِلَّةِ نَبِيِّكَ
Translation: And take me when You take me in Your faith and the faith of Your Prophet

Arabic text: مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّـلاَمُ إِذَا تَوَفَّيْتَنِي
Translation: Muhammad, peace be upon him

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَتُوْبُ إِلَيْـكَ فِيْ مَقَامِيْ هٰذَا
Translation: O Allah, I repent to You in this my position

Arabic text: مِنْ كَبَائِرِ ذُنُوْبِيْ وَصَغَائِرِهَا
Translation: From my major sins and my minor ones

Arabic text: وَبَوَاطِنِ سَيِّئَآتِيْ وَظَوَاهِرِهَا
Translation: From my secret evil acts and my open ones

Arabic text: وَسَوَالِفِ زَلَّاتِيْ وَحَوَادِثِهَا
Translation: From my past slips and my recent ones

Arabic text: تَوْبَةَ مَنْ لَا يُحَدِّثُ نَفْسَهُ بِمَعْصِيَةٍ
Translation: The repentance of one who does not tell himself to disobey

Arabic text: وَلَا يُضْمِرُ أَنْ يَعُوْدَ فِيْ خَطِيْئَةٍ
Translation: And who does not harbor the thought of returning to sin

Arabic text: وَقَدْ قُلْتَ يَا إِلٰهِيْ فِيْ مُحْكَمِ كِتَابِكَ
Translation: You have said, my God, in Your decisive Book

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ تَقْبَلُ التَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِكَ
Translation: That You accept repentance from Your servants

Arabic text: وَتَعْفُوْ عَنِ السَّيِّئَاتِ، وَتُحِبُّ التَّوَّابِيْنَ
Translation: And pardon evil deeds, and love those who repent

Arabic text: فَاقْبَلْ تَوْبَتِيْ كَمَا وَعَدْتَ وَاعْفُ عَنْ سَيِّئَاتِيْ كَمَا ضَمِنْتَ
Translation: So accept my repentance as You have promised, and forgive my evil deeds as You have guaranteed

Arabic text: وَأَوْجِبْ لِيْ مَحَبَّتَكَ كَمَا شَـرَطْتَ
Translation: And grant me Your love as You have stipulated

Arabic text: وَلَـكَ يَـا رَبِّ شَـرْطِيْ أَلَّا أَعُوْدَ فِيْ مَكْرُوْهِكَ
Translation: And to You, my Lord, is my commitment that I shall not return to what You dislike

Arabic text: وَضَمَانِيْ أَلَّا أَرْجِعَ فِيْ مَذْمُوْمِكَ
Translation: And my guarantee that I shall not go back to what You condemn

Arabic text: وَعَهْدِيْ أَنْ أَهْجُرَ جَمِيْعَ مَعَاصِيْكَ
Translation: And my covenant that I shall abandon all acts of disobedience to You

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا عَمِلْتُ فَاغْفِرْ لِيْ مَا عَلِمْتَ
Translation: O Allah, You know better what I have done, so forgive me what You know

Arabic text: وَاصْرِفْنِيْ بِقُدْرَتِكَ إِلَى مَا أَحْبَبْتَ
Translation: And turn me through Your power to what You love

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ وَعَلَيَّ تَبِعَاتٌ قَدْ حَفِظْتُهُنَّ
Translation: O Allah, upon me are obligations that I have remembered

Arabic text: وَتَبِعَاتٌ قَدْ نَسِيْتُهُنَّ
Translation: And obligations that I have forgotten

Arabic text: وَكُلُّهُنَّ بِعَيْنِكَ الَّتِيْ لَا تَنَامُ
Translation: And all of them are before Your eye that never sleeps

Arabic text: وَعِلْمِكَ الَّذِيْ لَا يَنْسَى
Translation: And Your knowledge that never forgets

Arabic text: فَعَوِّضْ مِنْهَا أَهْلَهَا وَاحْطُطْ عَنِّيْ وِزْرَهَا
Translation: So compensate their owners and lift their burden from me

Arabic text: وَخَفِّفْ عَنِّيْ ثِقْلَهَا، وَاعْصِمْنِيْ مِنْ أَنْ اُقَارِفَ مِثْلَهَا
Translation: And lighten their weight upon me, and protect me from committing similar ones

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ وَإِنَّهُ لَا وَفَاءَ لِيْ بِالتَّوْبَةِ إِلَّا بِعِصْمَتِكَ
Translation: O Allah, I cannot be faithful to my repentance without Your protection

Arabic text: وَلَا اسْتِمْسَاكَ بِيْ عَنِ الْخَطَايَا إِلَّا عَنْ قُوَّتِكَ
Translation: Nor can I refrain from sins except through Your strength

Arabic text: فَقَوِّنِيْ بِقُوَّةٍ كَافِيَةٍ، وَتَوَلَّنِيْ بِعِصْمَةٍ مَانِعَةٍ
Translation: So strengthen me with sufficient strength and attend to me with protective safeguarding

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ أَيُّمَا عَبْدٍ تَابَ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: O Allah, any servant who repents to You

Arabic text: وَهُوَ فِيْ عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ فَاسِخٌ لِتَوْبَتِهِ
Translation: While in Your knowledge of the unseen he will break his repentance

Arabic text: وَعَائِدٌ فِيْ ذَنْبِهِ وَخَطِيْئَتِهِ
Translation: And return to his sin and error

Arabic text: فَإِنِّيْ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ اَنْ أَكُوْنَ كَذَالِكَ
Translation: I seek refuge in You from being like that

Arabic text: فَاجْعَلْ تَوْبَتِيْ هٰذِهِ تَوْبَةً لَا أَحْتَاجُ بَعْدَهَا إِلَى تَوْبَةٍ
Translation: So make this repentance of mine a repentance after which I will need no repentance

Arabic text: تَوْبَةً مُوْجِبَةً لِمَحْوِ مَا سَلَفَ، وَالسَّلاَمَةِ فِيْمَـا بَقِيَ
Translation: A repentance which will obligate the erasing of what has passed and safety in what remains

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَعْتَـذِرُ إِلَيْـكَ مِنْ جَهْلِي
Translation: O Allah, I ask Your pardon for my ignorance

Arabic text: وَأَسْتَـوْهِبُـكَ سُوْءَ فِعْلِي
Translation: And I ask You to disregard my evil acts

Arabic text: فَاضْمُمْنِيْ إِلَى كَنَفِ رَحْمَتِكَ تَطَوُّلًا
Translation: So include me in the shelter of Your mercy by Your grace

Arabic text: وَاسْتُرْنِيْ بِسِتْرِ عَافِيَتِكَ تَفَضُّلًا
Translation: And cover me with the covering of Your well-being by Your favor

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ وَإِنِّيْ أَتُوْبُ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: O Allah, I repent to You

Arabic text: مِنْ كُلِّ مَا خَالَفَ إِرَادَتَكَ
Translation: From everything that opposes Your will

Arabic text: أَوْ زَالَ عَنْ مَحَبَّتِـكَ
Translation: Or departs from Your love

Arabic text: مِنْ خَـطَرَاتِ قَلْبِي
Translation: Of the thoughts of my heart

Arabic text: وَلَحَـظَاتِ عَيْنِي
Translation: And the glances of my eye

Arabic text: وَحِكَايَاتِ لِسَانِي
Translation: And the narratives of my tongue

Arabic text: تَوْبَةً تَسْلَمُ بِهَا كُلُّ جَارِحَةٍ عَلَى حِيَالِهَا مِنْ تَبِعَاتِكَ
Translation: A repentance through which each of my limbs will be safe from Your punishments

Arabic text: وَتَأْمَنُ مِمَّا يَخَافُ الْمُعْتَدُوْنَ مِنْ أَلِيْمِ سَطَوَاتِكَ
Translation: And secure from what the transgressors fear of Your painful penalties

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ فَارْحَمْ وَحْدَتِيْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ
Translation: O Allah, have mercy on my solitude before You

Arabic text: وَوَجِيْبَ قَلْبِيْ مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ
Translation: And the pounding of my heart in fear of You

Arabic text: وَاضْطِرَابَ أَرْكَانِيْ مِنْ هَيْبَتِكَ
Translation: And the trembling of my limbs in awe of You

Arabic text: فَقَدْ أَقَامَتْنِيْ يَا رَبِّ ذُنُوْبِيْ مَقَامَ الْخِزْيِ بِفِنَائِكَ
Translation: My Lord, my sins have placed me in the position of disgrace in Your courtyard

Arabic text: فَإِنْ سَكَتُّ لَمْ يَنْطِقْ عَنِّيْ أَحَدٌ
Translation: If I remain silent, no one will speak on my behalf

Arabic text: وَإِنْ شَفَعْتُ فَلَسْتُ بِأَهْلِ الشَّفَاعَةِ
Translation: And if I seek to intercede, I am not worthy of intercession

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَشَفِّعْ فِيْ خَطَايَـايَ كَرَمَكَ
Translation: And let Your generosity intercede for my sins

Arabic text: وَعُدْ عَلَى سَيِّئَاتِيْ بِعَفْوِكَ
Translation: And return to my evil deeds with Your pardon

Arabic text: وَلَا تَجْزِنِيْ جَزَائِيْ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ
Translation: And do not repay me with the punishment I deserve

Arabic text: وَابْسُطْ عَلَيَّ طَوْلَكَ وَجَلِّلْنِيْ بِسِتْرِكَ
Translation: And spread over me Your grace and cover me with Your protection

Arabic text: وَافْعَلْ بِيْ فِعْلَ عَزِيْزٍ تَضَرَّعَ إِلَيْهِ عَبْدٌ ذَلِيْلٌ فَرَحِمَهُ
Translation: And do with me what a mighty one does when a humble slave implores him and he has mercy on him

Arabic text: أَوْ غَنِيٍّ تَعَرَّضَ لَهُ عَبْدٌ فَقِيْرٌ فَنَعَشَهُ
Translation: Or like a rich one when approached by a poor slave and he raises him up

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ لَا خَفِيْرَ لِيْ مِنْكَ فَلْيَخْفُرْنِيْ عِزُّكَ
Translation: O Allah, I have no protector against You, so let Your might protect me

Arabic text: وَلَا شَفِيْعَ لِيْ إِلَيْكَ فَلْيَشْفَعْ لِيْ فَضْلُكَ
Translation: And I have no intercessor with You, so let Your grace intercede for me

Arabic text: وَقَدْ أَوْجَلَتْنِيْ خَطَايَايَ فَلْيُؤْمِنِّيْ عَفْوُكَ
Translation: My sins have terrified me, so let Your pardon give me security

Arabic text: فَمَا كُلُّ مَا نَطَقْتُ بِهِ عَنْ جَهْلٍ مِنِّيْ بِسُوْءِ أَثَرِي
Translation: For not all that I have said was from my ignorance of the evil consequences of my actions

Arabic text: وَلَا نِسيَانٍ لِمَا سَبَقَ مِنْ ذَمِيْمِ فِعْلِي
Translation: Nor from forgetfulness of my blameworthy acts in the past

Arabic text: لٰكِنْ لِتَسْمَعَ سَمَاؤُكَ وَمَنْ فِيْهَـا
Translation: But so that Your heaven and those in it

Arabic text: وَأَرْضُكَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا مَا أَظْهَرْتُ لَكَ مِنَ النَّدَمِ
Translation: And Your earth and those upon it may hear the remorse which I have expressed to You

Arabic text: وَلَجَـأْتُ إِلَيْكَ فِيْـهِ مِنَ التَّوْبَـةِ
Translation: And the repentance through which I have sought refuge with You

Arabic text: فَلَعَـلَّ بَعْضَهُمْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَرْحَمُنِيْ لِسُوْءِ مَوْقِفِي
Translation: Perhaps one of them, through Your mercy, will show mercy to my evil position

Arabic text: أَوْ تُدْرِكُهُ الرِّقَّةُ عَلَيَّ لِسُوْءِ حَالِي
Translation: Or feel compassion for my bad condition

Arabic text: فَيَنَالَنِيْ مِنْهُ بِدَعْوَةٍ أَسْمَعُ لَدَيْكَ مِنْ دُعَائِي
Translation: So there will reach me from him a supplication more heard by You than my supplication

Arabic text: أَوْ شَفَاعَـةٍ أَوْكَدُ عِنْدَكَ مِنْ شَفَاعَتِي
Translation: Or an intercession more effective with You than my intercession

Arabic text: تَكُونُ بِهَا نَجَاتِيْ مِنْ غَضَبِكَ وَفَوْزَتِيْ بِرِضَاكَ
Translation: By which I may be rescued from Your anger and attain Your pleasure

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ اِنْ يَكُنِ النَّدَمُ تَوْبَةً إِلَيْكَ فَأَنَا أَنْدَمُ النَّادِمِيْنَ
Translation: O Allah, if remorse is repentance to You, then I am the most remorseful of the remorseful

Arabic text: وَإِنْ يَكُنِ التَّرْكُ لِمَعْصِيَتِكَ إٍنَابَةً فَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُنِيْبِيْنَ
Translation: And if abandoning disobedience is turning to You, then I am the first of those who turn to You

Arabic text: وَإِنْ يَكُنِ الْأِسْتِغْفَارُ حِطَّةً لِلْذُّنُوْبِ فَإِنِّيْ لَكَ مِنَ الْمُسْتَغْفِرِيْنَ
Translation: And if asking forgiveness removes sins, then I am one of those who seek Your forgiveness

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا أَمَرْتَ بِالتَّوْبَةِ وَضَمِنْتَ الْقَبُولَ
Translation: O Allah, as You have commanded repentance and guaranteed acceptance

Arabic text: وَحَثَثْتَ عَلَى الدُّعَـاءِ وَوَعَدْتَ الْإِجَابَةَ
Translation: And urged supplication and promised response

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَاقْبَلْ تَوْبَتِي
Translation: So bless Muhammad and his family, and accept my repentance

Arabic text: وَلَا تَرْجِعْنِيْ مَرْجَعَ الخَيْبَةِ مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: And do not return me with disappointment from Your mercy

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ عَلَى الْمُذْنِبِيْنَ
Translation: Surely You are the Acceptor of Repentance from sinners

Arabic text: وَالرَّحِيْمُ لِلْخَاطِئِيْنَ الْمُنِيْبِيْنَ
Translation: And the Merciful to those who err and turn in repentance

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ كَمَا هَدَيْتَنَا بِهِ
Translation: O Allah, bless Muhammad and his family as You have guided us through him

Arabic text: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ كَمَا اسْتَنْقَذْتَنَا بِهِ
Translation: And bless Muhammad and his family as You have saved us through him

Arabic text: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: And bless Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: صَلاَةً تَشْفَعُ لَنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَيَوْمَ الْفَاقَةِ إِلَيْكَ
Translation: A blessing that will intercede for us on the Day of Resurrection and the Day of Need before You

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ وَهُوَ عَلَيْكَ يَسِيْرٌ
Translation: Indeed, You have power over all things, and that is easy for You
